output.description: HS 090111 covers coffee that has not been roasted or decaffeinated, i.e. raw green coffee beans in their unprocessed state. It sits within HS 0901, the broader heading for coffee in all its roasted/decaffeinated variants along with coffee husks, skins, and coffee substitutes, itself part of Section II (vegetable products). This code represents coffee at its earliest tradeable stage, before any roasting or caffeine-removal processing is applied.
